headline: prevent_destroy guard removed from production data bucket to work around a one-week CI failure without explaining the root cause
suppressed: Adding the CostCenter tag is appropriate and adds no risk.

findings.evidence_ref: Removal of lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } block (lines 41-43 of data_stores.tf)
findings.explanation: The prevent_destroy guard prevented accidental deletion of this production data bucket via terraform destroy or misconfigured automation. Removing it exposes the data to loss. The PR states CI has failed for a week but does not explain what the actual conflict is, suggesting this removes a necessary protection rather than fixing an underlying problem.
